inputs.initial_coordinates: Published equilibrated PDB; no extra equilibration or minimization in supplied driver.

energy_series.reason: Driver collects energies then writes only mean and final values. Full-series identity requires retaining samples in later implementation; no such implementation run during intake.

timing_scope.ensemble: perf_counter starts before first integrator/context creation; stops after final context and integrator deletion. Includes per-replica context setup/JIT, position and velocity initialization, integration and energy reads.
timing_scope.per_replica: Starts after context, positions and velocities initialized; includes integration and energy reads; excludes context creation and deletion.
timing_scope.concurrent_method: Compare complete eight-replica ensemble elapsed time including every replica context setup, integration, energy sampling, and completion; sum of individual process times is not ensemble wall time.
timing_scope.concurrent_command_reason: Brief supplies sequential driver only; independent publication supplies fixed-time MPS process pattern. No published fixed-work MPS ensemble launcher verified.

scoring_interface.primary_metric: Ensemble time to completion, seconds; lower is better.
scientific_outputs: Per-replica final potential energy in kJ/mol
Per-replica mean potential energy over 100 samples in kJ/mol
Potential energy every 250 steps, when retained

scientific_acceptance.reason: No independently published energy acceptance criterion or fixed-work baseline energies. Brief predicts bit-identical series; fallback uses unquantified same-seed sequential run-to-run variation.
scientific_acceptance.brief_proposed_rule: Same-seed energy series identical; if not identical, mean-energy difference no greater than sequential same-seed run-to-run variation.
scientific_acceptance.fallback_threshold_reason: No baseline variability, repetition count, statistic, or numeric threshold supplied.

scoring_interface.performance_acceptance_reason: Brief GPU-specific speedup ranges are predictions, not published acceptance criteria. Published fixed-time throughput reference has no tolerance.

repeatability.reason: Brief does not specify full-workload repeat count.
repeatability.limitation: Deterministic forces do not independently establish complete stochastic trajectory equality under MPS. Brief only reports CPU smoke testing, not CUDA reproduction.

budget_policy: Use supplied defaults: setup, anchors, profile, method_setup, method_run=1200 s; tests=900 s; evaluate=2400 s. No timing measurements performed.

runtime_evidence.expected_wall_time: Brief estimates about one minute on H100, a few minutes on slower GPUs.
runtime_evidence.reason: Only CPU smoke run reported; full CUDA workload and context setup time unmeasured.

scale_policy: Single fixed ensemble; no scale search, doubling loop, or toy extrapolation.
gate_scripts_reason: No gate script paths or commands supplied. JSON structure and cross-file consistency checked without builds or workloads.
